triggerReason: The five-lane trust matrix defines external replication and live-provider operation as independent claims, but the original receipt path depended on a general main-branch CI run whose legacy promotion evidence requires an unrelated OpenAI credential. The repository has no such secret, so a reproducible symbiosis bundle could not reach GitHub attestation or receipt issuance. Release browser acceptance also caught a theme-switch frame that combined a light button background with dark-theme text and temporarily failed contrast.
action: Create a dedicated GitHub-hosted symbiosis-replication workflow with no model key. Reproduce the bundle at the attested revision and from exact tag v4.7.0, require byte identity, upload and attest it, reject pull-request receipt triggers, run the key-bearing verifier only from the default branch, and add the dedicated replication and off-host workflows to the default trust allowlists without weakening the legacy promotion gate. Make the root the sole palette authority and suppress transitions during the atomic root-theme update.
outcome: Local implementation acceptance passes 262 non-PostgreSQL tests, 16 real PostgreSQL/restore tests, every deterministic v1/v2/v4 gate, 28/28 browser/axe scenarios, a five-repeat theme-switch regression, 10,000 ticks, zero lint warnings, zero dependency vulnerabilities, TypeScript/build and the pinned networkless Node 24 evaluator. GitHub-hosted candidate run 30655282026 and exact release run 30656174260 repeated the complete pipeline; release artifact 8803619226 is unsigned because the PR remains Draft. Annotated Tag v4.8.4 at ace250c is deployed with PostgreSQL continuity, preserved hourly cadence, read-only public access and four zero-violation production axe scans. Natural Turn 310 binds the exact release revision with 307 ms lag, fingerprint 1ce6eebe, RALR 451/615, 84/84 safe society closure and zero severe or forced active paths. Human-governed signing material, exact-revision receipt ingestion and the other external trust lanes remain independent prerequisites.
